app.name: BacktestLab
app.tagline: Write your idea, see if it would have worked.

landing.heroTitle: Write your idea, see if it would have worked.
landing.heroSub: BacktestLab tests simple spot-market ideas on historical data and shows a clear report. No code, no leverage, no hype.
landing.prodNote: Create a free account to run backtests on real market data.
landing.how1b: Choose one of 5 simple templates such as moving-average crossover or RSI.
landing.how2b: Pick an asset, dates, capital, and fees. Everything is explained in plain language.
landing.how3b: Compare against buy-and-hold with equity, drawdown, and monthly views.
landing.f1b: Every parameter has a simple explanation. Spot markets only.
landing.f2b: Returns, drawdown, Sharpe, win rate, and trade counts — with overfitting warnings.
landing.f3b: Put two backtests side by side and see the difference clearly.
landing.f4b: Full RTL interface, both themes, keyboard accessible.
landing.sampleNote: Sample — illustrative data, not a real result.
landing.forTitle: Who is it for / who is it NOT for
landing.forYes1: want to learn how strategies behaved in the past;
landing.forYes2: prefer simple spot-market ideas with clear reports;
landing.forYes3: understand past results never promise future returns.
landing.forNo1: want trading signals or investment advice;
landing.faq1a: No. BacktestLab is an analysis and testing tool. Nothing here tells you what to buy or sell.
landing.faq2a: Spot markets only — stocks, ETFs, and crypto spot. No leverage, margin, or futures anywhere.
landing.faq3a: No. Pick a template, adjust a few numbers, and run.
landing.faq4q: Can past results predict the future?
landing.faq4a: No. Historical results do not guarantee future performance. Use reports to learn, not to predict.
landing.finalSub: Free plan includes 3 backtests per day. No card required.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.sub: Start free. Upgrade only if you need more runs.
pricing.mockNote: Payments are mocked in this demo. No real charge happens.
pricing.faq1a: Each completed run counts once against your daily limit.
pricing.faq2a: Yes — this is a mock demo, so nothing is charged. The real product will allow cancel anytime.
pricing.faq3q: Is there a free trial of Pro?
pricing.faq3a: Not in this demo. The Free plan is enough to try every feature.

run.oosHelp: Saves a holdout preference with your draft. The engine does not use it yet; the run always covers the full date range.
run.oosNotAppliedHelp: This preference is saved with your draft only. The engine does not support holdout validation yet, so results always use the full date range.
run.reviewHelp: Check every value. The run uses exactly these inputs.
run.dateRangeHint: Supported range: {{min}} to {{max}} (UTC). The end date must be before today, with at least 6 months of history.
run.badDates: End date must be after start date, with at least 6 months of history. Future dates are not allowed.

paramHelp.fastPeriod: Fast average length in bars. Smaller reacts faster.
paramHelp.slowPeriod: Slow average length. Larger smooths more.
paramHelp.oversold: Buy when RSI falls below this.
paramHelp.overbought: Exit when RSI rises above this.
paramHelp.lookback: How many bars define the range.
paramHelp.bufferPct: Extra % above the range to confirm.

run.subtitle: Set up a historical simulation. Every field below maps to what the engine runs.
run.strategyHelp: Pick the rule the engine will trade. You can fine-tune its parameters in the next step.
run.assetSectionHelp: Search the eligible catalog. Only assets with a genuine OHLCV source are listed.
run.providerSectionHelp: Availability is checked by the backend. Keyed providers stay disabled until a key is configured.
run.periodSectionHelp: Choose the historical window and the trading costs applied to every fill.
run.capitalHint: Starting cash in USD. Allowed range: 100 – 1,000,000.
run.feesHint: Commission per trade as a percentage. Allowed range: 0 – 5%.
run.parametersSectionHelp: Defaults are ready to use. Adjust only if you understand the effect.
run.advancedSectionHelp: Optional settings that are not part of the core run.
run.validationSummary: Fix the highlighted fields to continue.
run.selectProviderToContinue: Select an available data provider to continue.
run.runningHelp: Your backtest is running. You can cancel; nothing is saved until it finishes.
run.riskControlsHelp: Configure bar interval, stop-loss, take-profit, position sizing, and out-of-sample split.
run.oosValidationLabel: Enable chronological Out-of-Sample split (70% In-Sample / 30% Out-of-Sample)

results.title: Backtest results
results.overfitting: Fewer than 30 trades: treat these results with caution. Small samples can mislead.
results.confirmDelete: Delete this backtest? This cannot be undone.

explain.totalReturn: How much the strategy gained or lost over the tested period, after the configured fees.
explain.maxDrawdown: The largest peak-to-trough drop in the equity curve. A risk indicator.
explain.sharpe: Return earned per unit of volatility. Higher is smoother; not a promise.
explain.winRate: Share of closed trades that made money. Small samples can mislead.
explain.trades: Number of closed trades. Fewer than 30 is a small, noisy sample.
explain.vsBuyHold: Strategy return minus simply buying and holding the same asset.

results.selectTwo: Select exactly two runs to compare.
results.differentMeta: Note: different assets or periods — compare with care.

ma-crossover.name: Moving Average Crossover
ma-crossover.desc: Buys when a fast average crosses above a slow one.

rsi.name: RSI Oversold / Overbought
rsi.desc: Buys oversold dips, exits overbought rallies.

breakout.name: Breakout
breakout.desc: Buys when price breaks above a recent range.

mean-reversion.name: Mean Reversion
mean-reversion.desc: Bets prices return toward their average.

buy-hold.name: Buy & Hold benchmark
buy-hold.desc: Simply buys once and holds for comparison.

ema-cross.name: EMA Crossover
ema-cross.desc: Buys when a fast exponential average crosses above a slow one.

macd.name: MACD
macd.desc: Buys when MACD crosses above its signal line.

bollinger.name: Bollinger Bands
bollinger.desc: Buys when price closes below the lower band.

donchian.name: Donchian Channel
donchian.desc: Buys when price breaks above the prior channel high.

dca.name: Dollar-Cost Averaging
dca.desc: Holds the asset and accumulates steadily over time.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.desc: Buys when recent returns are positive.
